portrait.jantini1517: Sender Benedetto Fantini, a Ferrarese agent in Hungary, has no known portrait; the recipient ('V. S. Ill.ma') is unidentified.
portrait.marburg1635: Writer and recipient are both unknown (an anonymous officer or agent reporting to Kassel).
portrait.harley286: Private cipher record, no recipient; Sir Simonds D'Ewes has no identified portrait on Wikimedia Commons (no Wikidata P18; Commons has his monument and ledger slab). The frontispiece plate facing the vol. II title in the Commons PDF of Halliwell's 1845 edition (IA autobiographyan01hallgoog, page 10) shows a man c.1620s but its caption is illegible in the scan and the other scans (IA an00/an02, HathiTrust) lack the plate, so the sitter is unconfirmed.
portrait.harley7001: Writer Robert Reade (Windebank's nephew and secretary) and his cousin, probably Thomas Windebank, have no portraits on Wikimedia Commons (no Wikidata image for either).
portrait.r688: Stojan and the writer Mla[den?] Baki[ć?] are unidentified private people; no portraits exist.
portrait.r4349: Not a letter between people: an anonymous Dominican scribe's colophon for a convent (Strängnäs for Västerås).
portrait.andreae1616: A printed novel, not a letter between people; no sender or recipient.
portrait.mellon29: Not a letter between people: an alchemical book pseudonymously ascribed to Elias of Cortona (d. 1253), copied c. 1525 by an unknown scribe; no sender or recipient.
portrait.r3708: Sender is an anonymous Paris informant (signed with a monogram); the recipient is an unidentified member of the Nevers household ('vous' is distinct from code 24 = Nevers).
portrait.harley1582r8505: the memoir is anonymous and its recipient is unknown; no person to portray
portrait.mellon136: Not a letter between people: an anonymous 1798 alchemical book copied by an unknown scribe (Gottfried Klaussen?) and pseudonymously ascribed to Johann Arndt (d. 1621); a portrait of Arndt would misattribute it; no recipient.
portrait.hernannunez1674: Sender is Francisco Gutiérrez de los Ríos y Córdoba, 3rd Count of Fernán Núñez (1644-1721), envoy in Sweden 1670-75 (Wikidata Q5865936); his only Commons portrait, Joaquín Pro's 1780s etching (File:Joaquín pro-Retrato de Francisco Gutiérrez de los Ríos y Córdoba.jpg, the Wikidata P18), is tagged CC BY-SA 4.0, which the portrait rule excludes; the other Fernán Núñez portraits on Commons are later counts and dukes. Recipient Baltasar de Fuenmayor (Q132660302) has no image on Wikidata or Commons.
portrait.r1862: The sender is an unidentified Venetian ambassador at Rome (the letter does not name him); the recipient is an office, the Doge and Senate.

reveal.walsingham1572: Unread: the only cipher is one six-sign port name (plus one omitted name) in a clear letter-book copy, and no key survives to decode it.
reveal.jantini1517: Unread: the cipher was attempted and closed without a key, so no passage can be decoded sign by sign.
reveal.harley1582r8504: The only cipher is one word of seven signs (princes); no passage of 40 groups exists.
reveal.r8356: Not read: a nine-sign run and two boxed codes in a clear letter; no key survives, so no passage decodes sign by sign.
reveal.r8358: Only name codes in a clear letter, [3] read from context; the rest and a five-letter run need the lost key, so there is no decodable passage.
reveal.r8361: Clear letters with name codes; only [3] read from context, and [7], [9], H and a nine-sign run need the lost key, so there is no decodable passage.
reveal.r8362: Not a cipher: the letter is clear and its only signs are two boxed cover-name markers, so nothing decodes sign by sign.
reveal.guise1587: Sign-level labels were replaced by pinned letters during the reading; no glyph-to-letter pairing survives that a decoder can replay.
reveal.bayard1526: Nothing is read: no key or decoder exists to replay.
reveal.r688: Not a cipher: the text is clear Cyrillic, so there is no key or decoder to replay.
reveal.r1212: No sign-level transcription file: the reading was made by deciphering each run on the images with key R1211 against the contemporary gloss; the sign images cannot be reproduced (archive permission).
reveal.harley1582r8499: The reading file aligns signs and words by line, not sign to word, so no passage can be replayed sign by sign without inventing the alignment.
reveal.r7707: not read; no key or decoder
reveal.toulon1803: Unread: 3 of 67 text groups have values and no continuous passage decodes; the key survives only as an undigitised booklet.
reveal.mellon29: Unread: no letter of the cipher has a value, so no passage can be decoded.
reveal.r8364: Only the six-sign place name reads (VALERY); a reveal needs a passage of 40 or more groups decoded sign by sign, and the key for the rest is not available.
reveal.harley1582r8505: not read: there is no key or decoder to run over the transcription
reveal.vatican: The key and token alignment are Simon Klee's (simonklee.dk/farnese-letter); code boundaries are unwritten and no decoder that reproduces his segmentation is in this repository, so no sign-by-sign passage can be decoded here.
reveal.vieuville1587: Unread: the only decodable items are isolated code numbers; the three letter runs give no sense under key no. 16, so no passage decodes sign by sign.
